Glance 2026.10.09 improves portable storage and file browsing.

## 公告 / Notice

从本版本起，安装版与便携版分别存储数据和配置。安装版继续使用 AppData 和注册表；便携版将数据和配置保存在程序目录下。便携版用户可通过「设置 → 维护」中的迁移功能，导入原有安装版的数据和配置。

Starting with this release, installed and portable editions store their data and settings separately. The installed edition continues to use AppData and the Windows Registry, while the portable edition stores both in its application directory. Portable users can import their existing installed-edition data and settings using the migration option under **Settings → Maintenance**.

## Changes

- Keep portable settings, dependencies and application data beside the application, separate from installed data.
- Migrate installed settings and data from Maintenance, with an optional cleanup of the original data before restarting.
- Update portable copies from ZIP packages while preserving user data and restoring the previous version if replacement fails.
- Show the installed or portable distribution beside the version and restore About page interaction after switching pages.
- Make the multi-file list more compact, with file icons, separate extensions and an item count.
- Add folder navigation hints and full filename tooltips.
- Fix gallery mode when entering an image or video from a folder preview.
- Add descriptions to maintenance actions and hide migration when no installed data is available.
